title: The docs-after-code check misses a docs task that waits on a code story or through its parent
goal: backlog.py dependencies follows the depends_on of an item and of its ancestors and reads a dependency's scope through its descendants, so a docs task that depends on a code story whose touches sit in its tasks is refused at start and flagged by check; a test plants the story case and the parent case; found in the review of SP-6eifcza6 (ST-enbiym2z)

run: import sys;t=open('_tools/backlog.py',encoding='utf-8').read();i=t.index('def dependencies');b=t[i:i+3000];sys.exit(0 if 'ancestors' in b else 1)

repro_reason: the fix changes which items dependencies() walks; a planted story-to-task scenario is the item's own test, still to be written, and the repro reads the source until it exists
